decisive_readings.what: Nearest-signature g*d buckets over sample label-mean shifts divided by (sample separation 10 minus property buckets): all properties <=0.09, below 0.3 cutoff.

Bullet bucket g*d 2.34 vs topic coefficient 6.33 gives dep 0.37 >= 0.3 (bounded >=0.305); gender 0.14 below cutoff.
